messages:
Leah Kim: Short follow-up thread from today's strategy section \- thanks for the great questions live. Drop any clarification asks here.
Samir Desai: Quick one: when you say 'unified runtime' as our differentiator, how do we prioritize that vs cost features (quant, caching)? Which gets more marketing focus?
Leah Kim: Good nuance. 'Unified runtime' stays as the product North Star in PR/positioning. For the next 2 quarters we spotlight cost features in demand-gen and product docs because they convert better for self-serve buyers.
Nora Blake: For sales enablement, can we get a short line for SDRs: "When to pitch Dedicated vs Hosted"? A one-liner per case would be perfect.
Leah Kim: Yes  Hosted: fastest time-to-value & PLG trials. Dedicated: predictable throughput, SLOs, and compliance for enterprise. I'll post exact one-liners in #sales-enable later today.
Evan Holt: Competitor callout: should we avoid naming big cloud vendors publicly? Sales wants direct comparisons in a private deck.
Leah Kim: Public messaging: avoid name-calling. Private battlecard: explicit comparisons + rebuttals for SDRs and AEs. @Nora I'll attach battlecard to the sales enable folder.
Priya Nair: Market question: are we doubling down on SMB PLG (volume) or moving upmarket faster? Feels like both pull resources.
Leah Kim: Dual motion. Core PLG remains critical for funnel; simultaneous measured expansion upmarket via Dedicated pilots and solutions. Hiring & roadmap split reflects both.
Samir Desai: One operational ask: can the Product team publish a simple roadmap table with quarter and top bet (Optimize, Dedicated, Private) so eng teams can plan sprints?
Leah Kim: Yes  PMs will publish a compact roadmap table by EOW; includes expected lift % for unit-cost, SLA targets, and owners.
Nora Blake: Tiny ask: can we get a short FAQ about "fallbacks" with an example route policy we can paste into docs? Some customers asked for it post-demo.
Leah Kim: Absolutely. Example: policy chain = local-rlx-1 -> region-rlx-1-q -> fallback-rlx-0-small. Add latency brackets for each step. I'll push a short FAQ and diagram.
allhands-bot: Slides + recording uploaded: https://redwood.slides/all-hands/1773005678
Evan Holt: Thanks  please ping the channel when the one-pager and battlecard are live.
Leah Kim: Will do. OKR doc + short Q&A to follow by EOD tomorrow. Appreciate the follow-ups ":seedling:"
